description: Search CVEs by a word or phrase from their description, newest first. The words match whole, in order, and ignoring case. A query made only of short or common words, such as "of the", matches nothing.

page.description: the page to return, starting at 1

query.description: a word or phrase the description uses, such as ocsp or request smuggling, up to 500 characters
